approvals.title: Agent approvals
approvals.help: Sensitive tool calls from AI agents wait here. Approving runs the call once, as the agent's API key owner; denying discards it. Pending calls expire after 24 hours.
approvals.empty: No calls are waiting for approval.
approvals.approved: Approved. The call ran once and its result is stored.
approvals.denied: Denied. The agent will see the call as denied.
health.stale: %d pending, %d past expiry (expiry job not running?)
approvals.already_decided: Nothing changed: this call was already decided or has expired.
